modules.description:
List of kpatch modules to manage. Each item defines a patch module to install and load for a specific kernel version. See items schema for structure.
items:
  name: string - Name/identifier of the patch module
  kernel_version: string - The kernel version the patch is built for
  path: string - Path to the .ko (kernel object) patch file

auto_load.description: Whether to load all installed patch modules into the running kernel after installation.
